opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
A automobile & auto components tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Production volumes for the 2-wheeler industry grew by about 12% to an all-time high of roughly 26.7 million units.

opportunities.point: Growth in the 2-wheeler industry was driven by improving rural demand, shift towards premium vehicles, and steady adoption of electric vehicles.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Growth was driven by improving rural demand, shift towards premium vehicles and the steady adoption of the electric vehicles." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: LED lighting as a percentage of total automotive lighting stands at 63% for FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "As a percentage of total automotive lighting, the LED lighting stands at 60% (63%) in comparison to 60% during last 3 years." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 256 -> 283 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 233 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 161 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Receivables are stretching year on year.
Geopolitical tension, currency fluctuations, and cost pressures shaped up the operating environment.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Geopolitical tension, currency fluctuations and cost pressures continue to shape up the operating environment for business across the world yet the Indian automotive industry remained resilient" (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Supply chain disruption causes price escalations in a number of products.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "there is this whole supply chain disruption, which may -- which is causing price escalations in a number of our products." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Geopolitical tensions arose from the conflict in West Asia during the period.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Despite heightened geopolitical tensions arising from the conflict in West Asia, India continued to demonstrate remarkable economic resilience and retained its position as one of the fastest-growing major economies in the world." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun, Dec) are still in the cycle.
